paper.title_en: Operator-Space Entanglement Entropy in Random Fermionic Gaussian Dynamics
paper.abstract_en: We study the von Neumann operator-space entanglement entropy (OSEE) of initial product operators evolved under random gaussian dynamics, as modeled by a Brownian SYK$_2$ model. By exploiting a mapping to a domain-wall melting problem, we derive an exact expression for the time-dependent bipartite OSEE in the thermodynamic limit, and obtain an analytic characterization of the corresponding gaussian Page curve emerging at late times. Our results build on recent work on the entanglement dynamics in the all-to-all quantum simple exclusion process, leveraging tools from RMT, including the Coulomb-gas approach and a mapping to the free Jacobi process. Finally, based on our results, we discuss the possibility of relating the OSEE with non-gaussianity measures in the Heisenberg picture.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 研究随机费米子高斯动力学下算符空间纠缠熵，借助畴壁融化映射与随机矩阵理论给出精确解析结果，并讨论高斯Page曲线及与海森堡图像下非高斯性度量的关系；理论深度与解析严谨性信号较强，虽与引力基础主题仅边缘相关（Page曲线类概念），仍值得点入细读。
decision.title_zh: 随机费米子高斯动力学中的算符空间纠缠熵
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究初态乘积算符在随机高斯动力学（由Brownian SYK$_2$模型建模）下演化后的von Neumann算符空间纠缠熵（OSEE）。通过利用到畴壁融化问题的映射，我们推导出热力学极限下含时二分OSEE的精确表达式，并获得晚时出现的相应高斯Page曲线的解析刻画。我们的结果建立在关于全连接量子简单排斥过程中纠缠动力学的近期工作之上，运用随机矩阵理论（RMT）中的工具，包括库仑气体方法以及到自由Jacobi过程的映射。最后，基于我们的结果，我们讨论了在Heisenberg图像中将OSEE与非高斯性度量联系起来的可能性。
